| description = The boss of island four. This is generally the first boss a raid will encounter with DT. Come prepared with multiple tanks or a metric buttload of dps. He is slowable.

== Spawning ==

'''INCORRECT AND OUT OF DATE'''
[[Keeper of Souls]]' spawn mechanic has a special catch, going by old Allakhazam posts, that wasn't listed anywhere here on the wiki until time I originally posted this. We've confirmed this mechanic to be the case on P99 as well. There's a semi-hidden NPC named [[Nottap Ekim]] [http://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=20205] (only visible on track, probably spawns under or inside the island) that determines the Keeper of Souls' spawning. Nottap is supposed to spawn when any mob on the island is killed -- at which point a despawn timer for Nottap will begin to tick down; a secondary spawn timer for the Keeper of Souls' will begin when Nottap's despawn timer finishes -- but that doesn't appear to be the case here. Rather than starting on the death of any mob, the trigger for Nottap Ekim's spawning (and thus KoS' eventual spawn) is the griffon [[a Soul Carrier]] immediately to your left when facing the front door of the windmill on island 4. Once that [[a Soul Carrier]] is killed Keeper of souls will spawn in 60 to 90 minutes.
I just know for sure that the mentioned griffon is '''a''' trigger mob. -Bummey

As has happened the past 3 weeks, so happened again: Nottap Ekim will despawn after 90 minutes on the nose and immediately trigger the Keeper of Souls to spawn. Unlike the old Allakhazam posts, there does not appear to be a set of timers, only a single 72 minute timer from Nottap's spawning to Keeper's spawning.

When pulling mobs back to earlier islands to start Keeper's timer early make sure you have a tracker peep their track list for Nottap. Once Nottap appears on track the despawn/KoS timer will be active and you can begin clearing through Sky as normal.
'''END INCORRECT'''

'''P99 Green''' - Leaving above for historical context but some info is inaccurate above.
When killing a Soul Carrier and Nottap is not on track (basically default scenario) Keeper of Souls will spawn between 60 and 100 minutes. (Not 90 minutes as said above)
Nottap spawns upon the Soul Carrier's death and has a despawn time of exactly 2 hours and 30 minutes. Once Nottap despawns you can kill another Soul Carrier and trigger another Keeper of Souls in 60-100 minutes time. You can do this until you run out of Soul Carriers. 

Keeper of Souls has a despawn timer of 80 minutes
